title: Iligan students stage walkout vs. Pax Silica, Trump visit

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Students from the seven colleges of Mindanao State University–Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT) staged a campus-wide walkout on Tuesday to oppose the US-led Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s visit. The Pax Silica Initiative includes the construction of the proposed high-tech manufacturing and semiconductor hub in New Clark City, Capas, Tarlac. The project drew a multisectoral opposition over concerns about possible displacement, threats to ancestral lands and agricultural livelihoods, and the potential strain on local water and energy resources, as raised by groups opposing the initiative.
